modes.daily: daily work report for {from}. Run the collector, write the work log, then the submission report. Print the saved paths.
modes.weekly: weekly work report covering {from} to {to}. Reuse the daily work logs in log/ and collect only the missing days. Print the saved paths.

files.submission: Write the submission section; it goes into the PMS daily report form. Its shape: "{path}".
files.samples: How I word them (endings and vocabulary only, never a source of content): "{path}".
files.patterns: How I have filled it before (counted, not rules): "{path}".

read_first: Read those files first and follow them exactly.
